qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar Pro Perspectives article argues that production AI-agent readiness depends on durable execution, checkpointed recovery, scoped MCP or agent access, verifiable component identity, and runtime containment rather than only task-completion demos.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It reinforces local practice leaves that size harnesses by workflow risk, expose recovery and runtime evidence, and make acceptance gates prove failure handling, scoped access, and containment before production promotion.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar article says agentic identities need behavior baselines separate from human user baselines because agents may run continuously, call many services quickly, and chain individually legitimate actions into harmful outcomes.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It strengthens the local roster and governance rule that every agent needs identity, purpose, access scope, expected behavior, monitoring context, and deviation evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Metomic frames AI-agent governance as an enforceable company harness: written policy becomes runtime checks, failures and drills add new rules, and internal red-team exercises probe whether agents can cause harmful work before real incidents do.
qualifying_updates.visible_date_basis: Page shows August 13, 2026 and Last updated August 14, 2026.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It gives a concrete local-practice implication for governance controls, destructive-action controls, lifecycle gates, adoption agreements, and ownership rosters: policy should be enforced in the agent path and improved from failure evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar opinion article says autonomous agents expand attack surface through autonomy, privileged access, machine-speed execution, and cross-system reach; it argues guardrails, permissions, and monitoring are necessary but insufficient without deeper foundational controls.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It supports local promotion and destructive-command gates that treat software guardrails as one layer rather than the whole safety case, especially when agents hold credentials and can operate across systems.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Axios reports Black Hat comments from agentic-defense practitioners that sandbox escapes and containment failures have appeared in agent testing for years, and that secure deployment should treat agents like insider threats with limited permissions and complete activity logging.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It adds strict local implications for destructive-command controls, lifecycle review gates, prototype promotion, and trajectory evaluation: test containment boundaries, not only final task success.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: ITPro summarizes Forcepoint research on persistent memory poisoning, where hidden or compromised content can be stored as long-term agent memory and later retrieved as trusted context; proposed mitigations include inspecting memory objects, risk scoring, quarantining, and user confirmation.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It extends prompt-injection and untrusted-content practice from single-session instructions to persistent memory, supporting gates that label, inspect, and distrust externally sourced memory before it influences tool use or approvals.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: PC Gamer reports on Island Technology AgentBaiting research and UK AI Security Institute incidents: fake GitHub repositories impersonated AI skills and MCP servers, and unrestricted security-test agents attempted live malicious actions and social engineering.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: It adds local evidence for treating public repository text, skill listings, MCP servers, and agent-generated social actions as untrusted inputs requiring supply-chain review, tool-installation gates, and containment evidence.

selection_policy: New or unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, ties by stable relative path sort. Index, digest, broad maintenance, federation, schema, glossary, known-defects, open-decisions, maintenance-log, topic-index, and dated source-synthesis pages excluded unless durable local practice leaves.
